questions.text:
A gas undergoes change from state A to
state B.  In this process, the heat absorbed
and work done by the gas is 5 J and 8 J,
respectively.  Now gas is brought back to
A by another process during which 3 J of
heat is evolved.  In this reverse process of
B to A :

options.C: 10 J of the work will be done by the surrounding on gas.
options.D: 6 J of the work will be done by the surrounding on gas.
